title: 好吃的
intro: Chinese life happens around the table. Staples, fruit, being hungry, thirsty and full, and the verbs 要 / 想 / 给. Plus your first look at 了 for a new situation (我饿了) and for something done (我吃了), and the polite way to survive a grandmother who keeps feeding you.

饭.h: Food 饣 + 反 fǎn for the sound.

米.h: Grains of rice scattered around a stalk.

面.h: A face in a frame. Noodles were 麵 (with 麦 wheat) before simplification.

饺.h: Food 饣 + 交 (to join): dough pinched shut.

包.h: A wrapping 勹 around a baby 巳.

蛋.h: Something laid by a creature 虫.

苹.h: Plant 艹 + 平 píng for the sound. 苹果 echoes 平安 (safe and sound).

果.h: Fruit 田 hanging on a tree 木.

香.h: Grain 禾 warming in the sun 日 smells sweet.

蕉.h: Plant 艹 + 焦 for the sound.

西.h: A bird settling in its nest when the sun goes down in the west.

瓜.h: A melon hanging from its vine.

糖.h: Rice 米 + 唐 táng: sugar was once made from rice.

菜.h: Plants 艹 you pick 采.

肉.h: A slab of meat with marbling.

汁.h: Liquid 氵 + 十 for the sound.

饿.h: Food 饣 + 我: I want food!

渴.h: Water 氵 + 曷 for the sound.

饱.h: Food 饣 wrapped up 包 inside you.

了.h: A swaddled baby with no arms: finished, done.

要.h: A woman 女 with hands on hips 覀: I want!

想.h: A picture 相 held in your heart 心.

给.h: Silk 纟 + 合 (to join): handing over a gift.

还.h: Walk 辶 + 不: still going.

碗.h: Stone 石 (pottery) + 宛 for the sound.

杯.h: Wood 木 + 不 for the sound: an old wooden cup.

texts.title: 排排坐，吃果果

lines.p: pái pái zuò chī guǒ guo
lines.en: Sit in a row, eat some fruit,

lines.p: nǐ yī gè wǒ yī gè
lines.en: one for you, one for me,

lines.p: mèi mei shuì le liú yī gè
lines.en: little sister's asleep, so save her one.

notes: A sharing rhyme for kindergarten snack time.
果果 guǒ guo: baby talk for 水果. Doubling nouns is how toddlers talk: 饭饭, 狗狗, 车车.

texts.title: 包饺子

lines.p: mā ma wǒ è le xiǎo míng shuō
nǐ xiǎng chī shén me mā ma wèn
lines.en: 'What would you like to eat?' asked Mom.

lines.p: hǎo wǒ men yī qǐ bāo jiǎo zi ba

lines.zh: 小明包了一个，不像饺子，像包子！
lines.p: xiǎo míng bāo le yī gè bù xiàng jiǎo zi xiàng bāo zi
lines.en: Xiaoming made one. It didn't look like a dumpling, it looked like a bun!

lines.p: mā ma hé xiǎo míng dōu xiào le
jiǎo zi hǎo le zhēn hǎo chī

lines.zh: 小明吃了二十个：“我吃饱了！”
lines.p: xiǎo míng chī le èr shí gè wǒ chī bǎo le

notes: 包饺子: 'wrap dumplings', the verb for making them.
像 xiàng: to look like. 不像 = bú xiàng.

exercises.q: 我___吃饺子，可是今天没有。
exercises.why: 想 = would like / feel like (a wish). 要 = want, will have (a decision or request).
Ordering: 我要… is the normal, direct way. 我想要… is softer.
Drinks by the glass: 一杯.
Pairs: 一双筷子, 一双鞋.
Number + measure word + noun: 一杯水.

exercises.en: What would you like to eat?

exercises.p: wǒ xiǎng chī yī wǎn miàn tiáo
exercises.en: I'd like a bowl of noodles.

exercises.p: mā ma gěi wǒ yī gè píng guǒ

exercises.why: 饭碗 rice bowl (also slang for 'job').

scenario.title: 在奶奶家吃饭
scenario.setting: Dinner at Grandma's. She thinks you're too thin and will keep refilling your bowl.

a.p: fàn hǎo le kuài lái chī fàn

b.p: nǐ yào mǐ fàn hái shi miàn tiáo
b.en: Do you want rice or noodles?

opts.fb: Cheeky! 都要 = I want both.

c.p: duō chī diǎnr ròu nǐ tài shòu le
c.en: Have more meat, you're too thin!

opts.p: xiè xie nǎi nai wǒ zì jǐ lái
opts.fb: 我自己来 is the polite way to stop someone piling food on your plate.
Correct but blunt with Grandma. Softer: 谢谢奶奶，我自己来。

opts.p: wǒ chī bǎo le xiè xie nǎi nai
opts.fb: 吃饱了 is the polite 'I'm full'. Expect her to insist twice more.

opts.p: hǎo ba zài chī yī diǎnr

e.npc: 真乖！下次奶奶再给你做饺子。
e.p: zhēn guāi xià cì nǎi nai zài gěi nǐ zuò jiǎo zi
e.en: Good kid! Next time Grandma will make you dumplings.
